messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites GNU C++17 code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

samples.content:
<perturbed_code_1>
#include <bits/stdc++.h>

using namespace std;

using ll = long long;
using ld = long double;
using ratio_t = pair<ll,ll>;
using ratios = multiset<ratio_t>;

ll b, c, g, n, q, r, t, u, x, y, z; 
map<ld, ratios> result;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    cout.tie(nullptr);

    cin >> x >> y >> n;
    g = gcd(x, y);
    x /= g;
    y /= g;
    q = x / y;
    r = x % y;

    auto save_ratio = [&](ll a) {
        g = gcd(a, b);
        result[abs(ld(a - u * z) / t)].insert({b / g, a / g});
    };

    for (b = 1; b <= n; ++b) {
        g = gcd(y, b);
        c = b / g;
        z = y / g;
        t = b * z;
        u = q * t + r * c;
        save_ratio(u / z);
        if (u % z != 0) {
            save_ratio((u + z - 1) / z);
        }
    }

    auto p = *result.begin()->second.begin();
    cout << p.second << '/' << p.first;
}
</perturbed_code_1>
